title: 1x2 Splitter Feeding 1x1 Microring Resonator
summary: Photonic circuit where the output of a 1x2 splitter is connected to the input (bus) of a 1x1 microring resonator; the second splitter output is left available as a tap/through path.

blocks.notes: Standard 1x2 splitter (e.g., Y-branch or 1x2 MMI). One input port, two output ports.
Single-bus (all-pass) microring resonator with one input and one output on the bus waveguide (no drop port). Coupling gap/length and ring radius unspecified.

wiring_notes: Connect splitter output port #1 to microring resonator input (bus input).
Expose microring resonator bus output as an external output port.
Expose splitter output port #2 as an external output port (unused/tap).
Expose splitter input as an external input port.

objective.target_behavior: Split incoming light into two paths; one path passes through a single-bus microring resonator (spectrally selective through response), while the other path remains as a direct reference/tap output.
